behavior_evals.description: Prompts that activate the skill, with assertions on the expected output.

evals.prompt: Skalibruj Marketing Atlas pod mój biznes — sprzedaję kursy online dla project managerów w Polsce.
assertions: Asks questions in batches of 2-3, not all at once
Asks about business model, stage, and audience
Asks about Polish market regulations (since market = Poland)
Does not invent answers the user did not give
Mentions that other Atlas skills will read this context

evals.prompt: Calibrate Marketing Atlas. We're a B2B SaaS, US market, 5-person team, post-Series A, focus on lead generation.
assertions: Reads the user's pre-given context and does not re-ask answered questions
Asks only for missing fields (audience details, voice, channels, compliance)
Does not enable Polish market layer (US market)
Writes marketing-context.md with all known fields filled
Marks unknown fields as [not provided] rather than guessing
